proposal_set.extra_envs_note: coupled: the sub-flags are gated by the master VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER switch and are no-ops without it
proposal_set.name: aiter-dense-kernels
proposal_set.reason: aiter 0.1.20.post1 is installed in this image but vLLM's AITER master switch is off by default on most ROCm builds. At bf16 dense TP1 the hot path is GEMM + RMSNorm + attention, exactly what the aiter fused kernels replace. This is the single largest dense-path prior on MI300X and is a pure env flip, so a REVERT costs one bench. Sub-flags are listed explicitly rather than relying on the master switch cascading, and marked atomic because splitting them tests nothing.

proposal_set.name: full-decode-graph-capture
proposal_set.reason: At concurrency 4 with OSL 1024 the server runs ~1024 single-token decode steps per request with a batch of 4 - per-step Python/launch overhead is a large fraction of step time and throughput is nowhere near compute bound. FULL_AND_PIECEWISE captures the decode path as one full graph while keeping piecewise capture for prefill/irregular shapes, so it targets exactly that overhead without the shape-coverage fragility of FULL-only. Low risk: falls back to piecewise if capture fails.
